metadata.title: The Sharp Generalized Bogomolov Inequality
metadata.abstract: Let $(X,\omega)$ be a compact Gauduchon and astheno-Kähler manifold. Using $L^p$-approximate critical Hermitian structures, we establish a sharp generalized Bogomolov inequality for holomorphic vector bundles on $X$, without any semistability assumption. We further characterize the equality case by studying the Hermitian-Yang-Mills flow. If equality holds, every Harder-Narasimhan-Seshadri filtration is by holomorphic subbundles, and its stable quotients admit projectively flat Hermitian metrics. If, in addition, the bundle is not $\omega$-semistable, then $X$ is projective.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.workSummary: 在紧 Gauduchon 且 astheno-Kähler 流形上，不假设半稳定性建立全纯向量丛的锐广义 Bogomolov 不等式，并描述等号时 HNS 过滤和射影平坦商。
techniques: L^p 近似临界 Hermitian 结构
analysis.breakthrough: 将不等式扩展到非半稳定丛，并把等号与底空间射影性相联系。
analysis.limitations: 底空间双重度量条件不可省；非半稳定等号情形推出射影性的范围须按定理假设理解。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。

analysis.priorityReason: 连接丛稳定性、几何流与非 Kähler 几何的重要定量工具。
